name: Higher-form and non-invertible symmetries in quantum field theory
summary: Symmetry in field theory was extended from groups to extended operators and then to non-invertible symmetries described by fusion categories, explaining pion decay rates and phases of matter.

name: Fractal uncertainty principle and quantum chaos
to: spectral theory and quantum chaos on hyperbolic surfaces
summary: A Fourier uncertainty principle for fractal-like sets was proved in one dimension and used to show waves cannot be trapped on a hyperbolic surface, then extended to higher dimensions.

name: Cap set
summary: Croot-Lev-Pach and Ellenberg-Gijswijt used a low-degree polynomial argument to bound cap sets.

name: Prismatic cohomology
summary: A single cohomology theory was constructed that specializes to etale, de Rham and crystalline p-adic theories.

name: Undecidability in quantum games via combinatorial group theory
summary: Systems of equations encoded as games were used to show that unlimited entanglement can win certain nonlocal games with certainty and that finite-dimensional strategies cannot.

name: Neural tangent kernel
summary: Infinite-width networks were analysed as kernel machines and mean fields.

name: Lorentzian polynomials and log-concavity
summary: A class of polynomials unifies log-concavity statements across matroids, Hodge theory and discrete convex analysis, giving the strongest Mason conjecture.

name: Hodge theory via o-minimality
summary: Bakker-Klingler-Tsimerman used o-minimal definability for Ax-Schanuel and algebraicity of period maps.

name: Synthetic Lorentzian curvature from optimal transport (non-smooth singularity theorems)
summary: Triangle comparison with time separation and optimal-transport characterisations of Ricci curvature were combined to define curvature bounds without smoothness and to reprove the Hawking and Penrose singularity theorems there.

name: Condensed mathematics
summary: Topological spaces are replaced by condensed sets so that real functional analysis can be done in a setting with abelian-category structure, a key vanishing result being proved in July 2019.
